description: register_mail_handlers registers handlers via ClosureHandler which receives caller: C in JmapHandler::call but does not pass it to the handler closure. The CLAUDE.md says auth is the caller's responsibility, but the mechanism to pass auth context into a handler is present in the type signature and silently dropped. A contributor trying to use C for per-request auth will find it does nothing and may assume the design is complete.
title: caller context C is wired into JmapHandler but silently discarded by ClosureHandler
